segments.title: 3 animal facts that sound fake
segments.say: Three animal facts that sound fake, but are true. Number one.

segments.title: An octopus has three hearts
segments.say: An octopus has three hearts. And blue blood.

segments.title: Two hearts pump the gills
segments.say: Two hearts push blood past the gills.

segments.title: The third one stops
segments.say: The third feeds the body, and it stops beating when the octopus swims.

segments.title: Its blood is blue
segments.say: Its blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.

segments.title: Its arms think too
segments.say: Bonus: two thirds of its neurons are in its arms, not its head.

segments.title: This animal poops cubes
segments.say: Number two. This animal poops cubes. Real cubes.

segments.title: Not from a square bottom
segments.say: Scientists found the cubes are not shaped on the way out.

segments.title: Shaped inside the gut
segments.say: They take shape inside the gut, which has stiff and stretchy zones.

segments.title: Four stiff zones = 4 walls
segments.say: Four stiff zones could make the four walls of a cube.

segments.title: Some otters hold hands to sleep
segments.say: Number three. Some sea otters hold paws while they sleep.

segments.title: So they don't drift away
segments.say: It keeps them from drifting apart in the open ocean.

segments.title: Groups called rafts
segments.say: They sleep in groups called rafts, to stay safe and warm.

segments.title: Or wrap up in kelp
segments.say: Others wrap themselves in kelp, like a seatbelt.

segments.title: No blubber, just fur
segments.say: They have no blubber. Thick fur keeps them warm.

segments.title: Quick recap
bullets: Sea otters: some hold paws to sleep
segments.say: Quick recap: Octopus: three hearts, blue blood. Wombats: cube-shaped poop. Sea otters: some hold paws to sleep.
